sanitisation_note: No token, cookie, Keychain item, credential path contents, email, orgId, session_id, or full environment dump is stored here. The user's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR value is NOT recorded; only its presence and a SHA256 of the normalised path.

normal_profile_auth_ok.prompt: Return exactly AUTH_OK and nothing else.

project_isolated_auth_ok.prompt: Return exactly AUTH_OK and nothing else.

observed_init_surface.apiKeySource_note: none does NOT mean unauthenticated — subscription OAuth authenticated the session (result_is_error=false, result=AUTH_OK). apiKeySource only reflects whether an API-key env source was used; it was not.
observed_init_surface.memory_paths_note: absent because autoMemoryEnabled=false. When present in other runs it is a dict like {"auto": "..."}; the runtime parser must handle dict/list/string/null.

conclusion: Existing Claude Code CLI OAuth (claude.ai, pro subscription) authenticates BOTH a normal-profile query and a project-isolated query. Project isolation via --setting-sources project + --strict-mcp-config + project .claude/settings.json does NOT break auth, because it does not touch CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. The D3.3.2 failure was caused solely by overriding CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR to a temp dir, which pointed the CLI away from the real OAuth store. D3.3.3 harness must inherit the existing auth environment and never override CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.
